sloka: ज्येष्ठो भ्राता पिता चैव यः च विद्याम् प्रयच्छति ।त्रयः ते पितरो ज्ञेया धर्मे च पथि वर्तिनः ॥४-१८-१३॥
transliteration: jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitā caiva yaḥ ca vidyām prayacchati ।trayaḥ te pitaro jñeyā dharme ca pathi vartinaḥ ॥4-18-13॥

translations.english: The elder brother, the father, and he who imparts knowledge—these three, who conduct themselves on the path of righteousness, are to be known as fathers.
translations.hindi: इन्द्रतुल्य पराक्रमसस्पन्न कपिराज को मरा हुआ देख, यहद समरत कपिसेना भयभीत हो भागी जाती है
